items.title: Guidewire to Acquire UK Insurtech Hyperexponential for Up to $2.1 Billion
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, insurance software provider Guidewire has announced plans to purchase London-based hyperexponential to expand its artificial intelligence capabilities.

items.title: The Ardonagh Group Rebrands Managing General Agent Operations Under Orvia Name
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, ardonagh is unifying over $3 billion in gross written premium under the new Orvia Underwriting brand as part of a shift to a global operating model.

items.title: Quilter Appoints Kristy Barr as Managing Director for UK Platform and Investment Solutions
items.summary: According to Investment Week, quilter has announced the selection of Kristy Barr to take over leadership of its UK platform and investment solutions division.

items.title: French Lenders Face Investor Scrutiny Amid Economic and Political Turbulence
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, france's major banks prepare for third-quarter earnings reports under the cloud of sovereign debt exposure, rising bond yields, and ongoing political unrest.

items.title: J O Hambro Capital Management Launches $1.2bn Emerging Markets Strategy as UCITS Fund
items.summary: According to Investment Week, investment firm J O Hambro Capital Management has introduced its long-running emerging markets strategy as an Irish-domiciled UCITS fund.

items.title: First-time buyer expresses caution over proposed government housing loan scheme
items.summary: According to BBC, further details of the Your First Home scheme are expected in the Budget, but some prospective buyers and industry experts have raised concerns over long-term debt and interest rate risks.
